steps: Create a free personal GitHub account at https://github.com if you do not have one (use your real legal name).
Go to https://education.github.com/pack and click 'Get your Student Benefits' / 'Get your pack'.
Select Student, add your school-issued email address (or choose document upload if you have no school email).
Enter your school's name and describe how you plan to use GitHub.
If prompted, upload clear proof of current enrollment (student ID with current date/semester, class schedule, or transcript — name, school, and date must be visible).
Submit and wait for approval (usually a few days; confirmation email arrives when approved).
Return to https://education.github.com/pack, browse the partner offers, and claim the ones you will actually use (GitHub Pro, Copilot, JetBrains, cloud credits).
biggest_catch: This is free software and cloud credits, not cash — the $1,000 figure is unsupported and it can never pay you money, only save you money on tools.
